mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who is a freeborn of a state."
A citizen is a person who is a freeborn of a state.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a desire for self-preservation, and to expect them to proceed in the urgent manner that most Nigerians desire is to make them embark on an exercise in self-destruction or immolation."

The legislators' attitude is a desire for self-preservation, and to expect them to proceed in the urgent manner that most Nigerians desire is to make them embark on an exercise in self-destruction or immolation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the maintenance of equal opportunities for all citizens."
Liberty means the maintenance of equal opportunities for all citizens.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a limitation to the freedom of speech and writing if it defames or impugns the integrity of another person."
Law of libel is a limitation to the freedom of speech and writing if it defames or impugns the integrity of another person.
fib: ______ are regarded as the fulcrum of democracy.
Little wonder political parties are regarded as the fulcrum of democracy.
______ is the model of "pure" or consensus" democracy, though in the case of Greek pure democracy did not last long.
The Greek system of democratic government is the model of "pure" or consensus" democracy, though in the case of Greek pure democracy did not last long.
______ is a network of relationships through which parties interact and influence the political process.
Types of Party System A party system is a network of relationships through which parties interact and influence the political process.
______ is the heart of any democratic system.
The electoral system is the heart of any democratic system.
